V26-2821.summary: delivery-state/1 already has a runId on each queue element, but nothing sets it: delivery_state.py always writes null, and handoff has no way to name a run. The records design joins the delivery state (the present tense) to the adopter's runs (the history) on this field. This ticket makes the join real, in a form any adopter can use.
V26-2821.title: Delivery state links each candidate to its run: `handoff --run`, `runId` on planned work

V26-2822.summary: A review round is recorded twice today, by different hands:
V26-2822.title: One review-round write lands in the run and in the delivery state's journal

V26-2823.summary: Epic lanes record no runs today:
V26-2823.title: Epic lanes record runs: drop `ATHENA_DELIVERY_RECORDING=off` and `Run: none`, mark lane worktrees

V26-2824.summary: Once the agent-skills release carrying handoff --run (V26-2821) is out, Athena installs it, and lanes name their run at hand-off. Each queue element's runId then points at the run that built it, and the line map and the agreement sensor can follow it.
V26-2824.title: Install the release with `handoff --run`; lanes hand off naming their run

V26-2825.summary: The line map (scripts/delivery-live-view.ts, served by bun scripts/delivery-live.ts) becomes the operator's run surface. A stop whose queue or planned element has a runId shows that run's story beside the state:
V26-2825.title: The line map shows each stop's run: rounds, findings, waits and timings

V26-2826.summary: The line map shows one delivery as it stands now. Once it is the run surface, the operator also needs the past: earlier deliveries and the runs recorded before any delivery state existed. This includes single-ticket deliveries and older epics. Without that, the history recorded so far drops out of view.
V26-2826.title: A history page lists past deliveries and runs, including runs with no delivery state

V26-2827.summary: The recorder writes each review round to both the run and the delivery state's journal (V26-2822). Two copies can still drift: a write fails, or a round is journaled by hand. This sensor proves they agree, so the line map's stats and the run's history tell the same story.
V26-2827.title: A sensor confirms each candidate's review rounds agree between its run and the delivery state

V26-2831.summary: Main fails harness:test. #1146 (V26-2819) changed packages/athena-webapp/package.json and index.html without repinning scripts/harness-app-registry.ts. The failing tests are harness-app-registry ("keeps every pinned digest in the registry current", "keeps every guard on … the root package.json current"), the agent-browser contract, the report-caching pin and harness-contract-preflight. This ticket repins them so the base is green again. Lane-runs found it during V26-2823 (epic V26-2829), and the lead reproduced it on origin/main 225f83b72.
V26-2831.title: Repin the harness app registry after the landing-page rebuild

V26-2832.summary: bun run harness:behavior --scenario athena-convex-storefront-composition has failed deterministically (3 of 3) since #1018 (2026-10-17). The fixture scripts/harness-behavior-fixtures/athena-runtime-app.ts mounts storefrontRoutes without admission context, so /storefront returns 500 with "null is not an object (evaluating 'admitted.admission.actor')" at admittedCustomer.ts:59, and the browser phase times out waiting for its selector. Found by lane-runs during V26-2831 (epic V26-2829), after the merge queue's checks on V26-2823 ran the scenario. It is pre-existing and not caused by #1146.
V26-2832.title: The storefront-composition behavior scenario mounts storefront routes with admission context again
